text_block_list.text:
Today, Maruzensky is doing an interview 
for a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Then next, regarding the racing silks 
you are wearing today..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Racewear, huh? Fufu, it's totally decided, 
isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"The design has been very well-received by 
fans as well. What are your own 
impressions of it?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's a favorite of mine too. It's the 
ultimate outfit that brings out 100% of my 
charm."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I see. Is there any particular part of it 
that you like?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Between the design, the fit, 
and everything else, it's hard to pass on 
any of them, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Number one is color! A fiery red!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a color that's been close to my heart 
for ages. That's why Tacchan rocks red 
too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, maybe it's the opposite. 
It's been my aspiration since I was 
little, so maybe that's why I still love 
red like Tac-chan's."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Tac-chan?
choice_data_list:
It's the nickname of Maruzensky's beloved 
car

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I just got a little carried 
away♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That was back when I was a kid and got 
taken to a motor show..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And that's where I saw it—a bright red 
supercar! It was so cool, I fell in love 
in an instant!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As a kid, I made a vow. When I bought a 
car in the future, it would definitely be 
this one.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
After that, I did my best while gazing at 
catalog photos, dreaming of the day I'd 
get my license—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And now, I've totally made that dream come 
true, vroom-vrooming all over the place♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"So you still hold those deep-seated 
feelings just as strongly today, is that 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why I want to run in a way 
that gives everyone in the audience energy 
too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Just like that supercar everyone dreams 
of... you know?♪"
The interview proceeded smoothly...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now then, let's 
continue with the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Loud and clear! I'm gonna show off my 
charm with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The one who knows me best is 
Trainer-kun, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The one who knows me best is 
Trainer-chan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm to make an impression during 
today's photoshoot, what kind of vibe do 
you think would be best?"
choice_data_list: Speed that no one can catch up to
A calm, confident smile no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see. I shine the brightest whenever I'm 
having fun running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what should we do? Would it be 
alright if we used the racetrack?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why not just go for a drive? Reporters, 
you can hop in too and enjoy the speed 
with me♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, ride together?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo!! Tacchan's speed really is the 
absolute best!!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, isn't this... a bit too fast!? 
Ah, ahhh... AAAAAHHH!!!

Her expression as she enjoyed the drive, 
getting the reporters swept up in it too, 
was undeniably radiant...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A smile! That's right, enjoying everything 
to the fullest is number one. That's my 
motto, after all.
choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I'll live up to your 
expectations, Trainer, and flash you an 
ultra-cute smile!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I'll live up to 
Trainer-chan's expectations and strike a 
super-duper cute smile!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They call me the Roaring Supercar for a 
reason! Peace♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Looking great! Got a wonderful expression 
from you!

Later on, I checked the contents of the 
interview article together with 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's a great smile I caught on camera~. 
If I do say so myself, it's a purr-fect 
shot♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, look here... It seems like 
they've even mentioned you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, look here... It seems like 
they've even mentioned you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The unforgettable, radiant smile born 
from the trust between her and her 
trainer"... it says♪
choice_data_list: This is a little embarrassing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be modest. The reason I can keep 
smiling is all thanks to you supporting 
me, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be modest. The reason I can keep 
smiling is all thanks to you supporting 
me, Trainer-chan♪

Both in photos and right before my eyes, 
Maruzensky greeted me with her dazzling 
smile...
